final: WITH j AS (SELECT a.frequency AS frequency, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM j) SELECT j.frequency, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS ratio_total, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / av.avg_cnt AS ratio_avg FROM j JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL JOIN av ON av.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
